pages.text: Every Ender Dragon drops one $(item)Dragon Soul$() at the feet of its killer, or on top of the portal pillar if no player killed it.$(br2)The Origin Dragon Sword and Chestplate each need one, and so does summoning the Heavenly Dao.

Right-click the $(item)Mystery Altar$() while holding a Dragon Soul to offer it: a 20-second countdown begins in that dimension, then lightning strikes and the $(l)Divine Heavenly Dao$() descends above the altar.$(br2)Only one summoning can run per dimension at a time. Bring at least Origin gear, and build the altar somewhere open.
